description: This file defines label selector logic for Kubernetes, including selector interfaces, requirement parsing, and validation, used for matching label sets based on various operators.

classes.name: Requirement
classes.description: Represents a label requirement with key, operator, and values.

classes.name: internalSelector
classes.description: Implements the Selector interface as a slice of Requirements.

classes.name: nothingSelector
classes.description: Implements a Selector that matches no labels.

classes.name: sharedEverythingSelector
classes.description: Shared immutable Selector that matches all labels.

classes.name: sharedNothingSelector
classes.description: Shared immutable Selector that matches no labels.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Enumeration of lexer tokens for parsing label selector strings.

classes.name: ScannedItem
classes.description: Represents a token and its literal string during lexing.

classes.name: Lexer
classes.description: Performs lexical analysis of selector strings into tokens.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: Parses tokens into label selector requirements.

methods.name: NewRequirement
methods.description: Constructs a new Requirement with validation of operator and values.

methods.name: Requirement.Matches
methods.description: Checks if a requirement matches a set of labels.

methods.name: Requirement.Key
methods.description: Returns the requirement's key.

methods.name: Requirement.Operator
methods.description: Returns the requirement's operator.

methods.name: Requirement.Values
methods.description: Returns the requirement's values as a set.

methods.name: Requirement.ValuesUnsorted
methods.description: Returns the requirement's values as a slice without sorting.

methods.name: Requirement.Equal
methods.description: Checks equality with another requirement.

methods.name: Requirement.String
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of the requirement.

methods.name: internalSelector.DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the selector.

methods.name: internalSelector.DeepCopySelector
methods.description: Returns a deep copy of the selector.

methods.name: internalSelector.Add
methods.description: Adds requirements to the selector, returning a new selector.

methods.name: internalSelector.Matches
methods.description: Checks if all requirements match a set of labels.

methods.name: internalSelector.Requirements
methods.description: Returns the requirements and whether the selector is selectable.

methods.name: internalSelector.String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of all requirements.

methods.name: internalSelector.RequiresExactMatch
methods.description: Checks if the selector requires an exact match for a label.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a selector string into internalSelector.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Public function to parse a selector string into a Selector interface.

methods.name: SelectorFromSet
methods.description: Creates a Selector from a set of labels.

methods.name: ValidatedSelectorFromSet
methods.description: Creates a validated Selector from a set of labels.

methods.name: SelectorFromValidatedSet
methods.description: Creates a Selector from a validated set.

methods.name: ParseToRequirements
methods.description: Parses a selector string into a list of requirements.

methods.name: ValidatedSetSelector.Matches
methods.description: Checks if labels match the set.

methods.name: ValidatedSetSelector.Empty
methods.description: Checks if the set is empty.

methods.name: ValidatedSetSelector.String
methods.description: Returns string representation of the set.

methods.name: ValidatedSetSelector.Add
methods.description: Adds requirements, returning a full selector.

methods.name: ValidatedSetSelector.Requirements
methods.description: Returns requirements and if selectable.

methods.name: ValidatedSetSelector.DeepCopySelector
methods.description: Returns a deep copy of the selector.

methods.name: ValidatedSetSelector.RequiresExactMatch
methods.description: Returns value and presence for a label.
